text: Seychelles projects 2024 real GDP growth at 3.02 percent, lowered from 3.69 percent, while the public and publicly guaranteed debt-to-GDP ratio is projected to reach 61.5 percent by end-2024. All quantitative targets were met. IMF staff assessed that the current program performance-based budgeting approach is complex with insufficient strategic focus, recommending that medium-term budget framework preparation be aligned with good practice. The authorities request completing the third program review.
